campus_rules.summary: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each registered theory and laboratory course.
campus_rules.details: Students falling below 75% without authorized medical leave approved by the Dean of Academics (Room ADM-101) will not be permitted to take end-semester examinations. Medical certificates must be submitted within 3 working days of absence.

campus_rules.summary: Undergraduate students may borrow up to 4 books for 14 calendar days; graduate students may borrow up to 8 books for 28 days.
campus_rules.details: Overdue book fines are assessed at $0.50 per book per day. The 2nd Floor is an absolute 'Zero-Whisper Quiet Zone' where phone calls and video meetings are strictly prohibited. Open water bottles with sealed caps are allowed, but food is strictly forbidden.

campus_rules.summary: Closed-toe shoes, lab coats, and safety goggles are mandatory in hardware, robotics, and electrical laboratories.
campus_rules.details: No food or sugary beverages are allowed inside computing or hardware labs at any time. Any hardware equipment leaving TAI-102 or ST-301 requires an approved digital gate pass from the Lab In-charge.

campus_rules.summary: Connect to 'Specter-Secure-WiFi' using your student ID (e.g. s12345@specter.edu) and campus portal password.
campus_rules.details: Torrenting, peer-to-peer file sharing of copyrighted media, and unauthorized network scanning/penetration testing on university infrastructure are strictly grounds for immediate network suspension and disciplinary inquiry.

campus_rules.summary: Campus hostel main entry gates close at 10:30 PM on weekdays and 11:30 PM on weekends.
campus_rules.details: Late night entry after curfew requires prior night-out permission logged on the student portal at least 4 hours before gate closure. Overnight guests must be registered at the Warden's Office.

campus_rules.summary: Vehicles must possess a registered university parking permit sticker issued by Security Post A.
campus_rules.details: Free Level 2 EV charging stations are located behind Science & Technology Block (Parking Lot C). Charging is limited to a maximum of 4 continuous hours per vehicle.

faqs.question: Where is the Turing Robotics Lab?
faqs.answer: The Turing Robotics & Embedded Systems Lab is located in the Alan Turing Innovation & AI Center (TAI), Ground Floor, Room TAI-102. It is equipped with soldering benches, 3D printers, and robotic arm arenas.

faqs.question: What is the attendance requirement to appear for exams?
faqs.answer: Specter University requires a mandatory minimum of 75% attendance in each registered course. Students below 75% without approved medical leave cannot sit for end-semester exams.

faqs.question: How do I connect to campus WiFi?
faqs.answer: Connect to 'Specter-Secure-WiFi' via WPA2-Enterprise. Enter your student email (e.g. s12345@specter.edu) as the identity and your campus portal password. Certificate validation: set to 'Do not validate' or use the university root certificate.

faqs.question: What are the Central Library hours and quiet rules?
faqs.answer: The Ada Lovelace Central Library is open from 08:00 AM to 11:00 PM on weekdays and 09:00 AM to 08:00 PM on weekends. The 2nd Floor is a strict Zero-Whisper Quiet Zone.

faqs.question: Where can I get my student ID card replaced?
faqs.answer: Visit the Registrar & Student Affairs Office in the Administrative Quadrangle, Ground Floor, Room ADM-101 (Open 09:00 AM - 04:30 PM Mon-Fri).

faqs.question: When is CS-302 Distributed Operating Systems held?
faqs.answer: CS-302 is held on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 10:00 AM to 11:30 AM in Room ST-101 (Ada Lovelace Computing Hall in the Science & Technology Block), taught by Dr. Eleanor Vance.
